name: Admin Blog Publish Mode
description: From the blog edit page, admin selects how the post should be published via three radio options: 'Borrador' (draft), 'Publicar ahora' (immediate), or 'Programar' (scheduled). Selecting 'Programar' reveals a datetime input for publish_scheduled_for. If the STORED schedule (published_at at hydration time) is in the past, an amber overdue banner ([data-test='scheduled-overdue-banner']) warns that the safety-net Huey task will publish on the next run; the banner is not live input validation. The mode is computed by frontend/utils/blogPublishMode.js (resolveBlogPublishMode → { mode, scheduledIso, overdue }) and submitted to the blog update endpoint.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 4): draft/schedule reveal, past-date overdue banner, scheduled hydration and the publish-now PATCH payload over mocked API.
